name: Chicago South Side
living: the elevated train's lit windows glow and flicker softly as it hums along the tracks
the twin antenna lights on the tallest tower blink slowly, white-blue
skyscraper windows flicker on and off across the downtown skyline
the HOME RUN DERBY board's dot lights chase slowly
the light-tower lamp banks breathe gently, moths drifting through their cones
dark night clouds drift slowly past the skyline (sky layer drift)
stars twinkle faintly above the towers
red aircraft-warning lights blink on the spires
a window in the right-field brick apartments switches on, later off
the passing el train's window light sweeps across the empty green bleachers
note: fences in m at spray -45 (lf) / 0 (cf) / +45 (rf) deg, optional lcf / rcf at -22.5 / +22.5; wallHeight = the painted wall's height (m) at the fence (qa.py --wall-height); wallProfile (optional) = spray ranges where the painted wall is much taller/shorter; living = suggested living-painting details for this park (masks, sprites, shaders)
